content.rendered:
Our last day of school for 2023 is Friday, December 15th. There will be no school for students December 18th – January 1st. January 2nd is a Professional Development day for staff, with no school for students. Students will return on Wednesday, January 3rd which is an early release day with dismissal at 1:15.

Wishing everyone a happy holiday season!
